content: Wainaḡi soinama wainasinama
Be Yesu wainasi ḡesau ya riuedina,
“Mamaitua na waiguyauma inam maika umanama: Guyau tenaḡa natunama tauḡominama yawai naḡina. Vutuna aubainama tauna soi ya vokaukauena.
Be tauna na taunoyama ya riuporedina da banaga ya kokokokonedina, vutudi sibo a riuedi da a verauna soie. Be inam banegidima taudi a tuaḡaina.

Naumeki da tauna na taunoyama ḡesaudima rautoitoi ya riupore nawedi be ya riuna, ‘Ko naḡo inam banegidima è kokokokonedina ḡarodie be umanama ko riuedina, “Ko verauna soie! Taugu kaite yau kani be yau musarama è vokaukauedi, be taumi yà raberabemina.” ’
Be inam banegidima yaḡoro taunoya bonedima a vaia tuaḡaiedi, be taudi ai naḡo teḡateḡana. Waria na sipie ya naḡona, be waria na noyae ya naḡona.
Be ḡesaudima taunoya a vunuḡidi, a raukivi gewegewedi be ai guridina.
“Vutuna aubainama guyau noponama yai ḡora kaua be na tauiḡarama ya riuporedina da inam banegidima taurau vunuḡa tai guridi be adi meagaima mate ta gabu gorudina.
Dabudine guyau na taunoyama ya riuedina, ‘Naḡi soinama kaite e kawa nonoḡi be e kenakenana. Be banaga è kokokokonedina, taudi nam veredi da sibo a verau.
Vutuna aubainama taumi ko naḡo kedaḡa be aitauḡa ko banabanavidina, ko riuedi be matabudi ta verauna soie.’
“Naumeki da taunoya a naḡo kedaḡa be banaga aitauḡa a banabanavidina, veredi bo gewegewedi, matabudi a tavaitedi, be soi vadanama ya moḡavu taritarina.
Be guyau vadae ya saḡana, na warema kitedima aubainama. Be dabudine e kitana be banaga tenaḡa nam naḡi garedima i kotedina.
Dabudine guyau inam baneginama ya riuena, ‘Badam, tam nam naḡi garedima ku kotedina, be nemanama da uma dabudine kuya saḡa?’ Be tauḡoma dabudine nam aiyaba i riuena.
Dabudine guyau na taunoyama ya riuedina, ‘Inam tauḡominama nimanama, kaḡanama ko panidi be ko pore dobiḡena tadiwanawanae. Be dabudine e ḡaba be gadigadinama e sanadididina.’
“Ko kataie da Mamaitua banaga toitoi ya kokonedina be bisaḡa ya vinedina.”
Tài teks bo ibewa?
Dabudine Parisi a naḡo da adi ogama a taraḡina da tauna sibo giue Yesu ai sinasina be aiyaba sibo ya vato waigewana.

Be Parisi adi tauwai muriwatanama be Herod na tauwai muriwatanama a riupore nawe tenaḡedi, be Yesu ai taravirena, “Tauwai katakatai, tauma kè kataiena da tam riukaue kwa giugiuna, be Mamaitua na ḡoanama riukaue kwawai katakataina. Be am giue tam nam banaga kuma nainairedina, avedi da banaga nema maika kitedima, tam nam kuma siesievidina.
Kwa riuemai, tam nema kwa noḡonoḡota bake, tauma Sisa ḡarone kai teks bo avedi?”
Dabudine Yesu taudi adi noḡotama gewegewedima ya kataiedi be ya riuna, “Taumi banaga kaikaiyovumima! Aba aubainama taumi ko rarau rubugu?
Sirin teks aniwai maesinama ko verauḡe be yà kita.” Naumeki da Denari tenaḡa a paḡo verauḡe ḡarone
be Yesu taudi yai taraviredina, “Aitau noḡona be isanama Sirin bogane ta kenakena?”
Be taudi a paribee be a riuna, “Uma Sisa noḡonama.” Be Yesu ya riuedina, “Naumeki da Sisa ḡaronama Sisa ko utena, be Mamaitua ḡaronama naumeki da Mamaitua ko utena!”
Raḡanine nama giunama a vaivaiena, taudi Yesu a base be a naḡona.
Gurie be midisuḡu munaḡa waitaraviranama
Sadisi taudi a riuriuna da banaga e guri be nam e midisuḡu munaḡa. Inam raḡaninama teneḡine taudi vutudi Yesu ḡarone a tava da ai taravire

be a riuna, “Tauwai katakatai, Mousis umanama ya riuna, ‘Deḡoda tauḡoma yai naḡi be nam seda i tikedi da ya gurina, be na visarama ya gosena, naumeki da tasinama bo tuaḡanama inam kaiyababinama e naḡi be seda ei tubuḡidina tuaḡanama gurigurinama aubainama.’
“Tauma ḡaromaie tautauḡoma 7 a tubuḡana tina tenaḡa ḡarone, be tauḡoma tautuaḡa waivi ya naḡi da nam ti natunatuna, be tauḡominama ya gurina be tasinama tuaḡanama kaiyababinama ya naḡina.

Be tauna mate seda nam i tikedi be ya gurina. Be kauinama teneḡinama tauḡoma wairabuiteḡanama ḡarone ya tubuḡana. Namaḡa da tauḡoma aniwai 7-nama ḡarone ya dobina. Be inam tauḡominama mate nam i natunatuna be ya gurina.
Naumeki da inam tautauḡomidima a gurigurina damone inam waivinama ya guri ḡavutana.
Yodi nemanama? Midisuḡu munaḡa na raḡanie uma waivinama tautauḡoma 7 a naḡinaḡina, tauna tokare aitau na waivi?”
Yesu ya paribeedi be ya riuna, “Taumi koya giu waigewana, baninama taumi girugiruminama porane nam ko katai kauena, be Mamaitua na rewapanama mate nam ko kataiena.
Midisuḡu munaḡa raḡanine, banaga taudi tokare anea maika ta tubuḡana marae, be tokare nam tai naḡi.
Be guri ta midisuḡu munaḡana na waikatakataima taumi koya sievi bo ibewa? Mamaitua boni umanama ya riuna,
‘Taugu inam Eibraham, Aisik be Jeikob adi Mamaituama.’ Mamaitua, nam banaga guriguridima adi Mamaitua, ibewa da tauna banaga yawayawasanidima adi Mamaituama.”
Patara umanama giudima a vaivaiena, taudi Yesu na waikatakataima a base kauena.
Riuvavasaḡa dosinama
Inam raḡanine Parisi ta vaiena be Yesu Sadisi adi giuma matabudi ya gududina, vutuna aubainama Parisi a rawateḡeidina.
Be adi badama, tarawatu tauwai katakatainama tenaḡa Yesu ya raurubu be ya riuena,
“Tauwai katakatai, tarawatu nopone, deḡo riuvavasaḡinama ya saḡa vavasaḡa?”
Be Yesu ya paribeena, ‘Bada am Mamaituama nuanuamma e paḡona, nuanuamma tabutabune, aruimma tabutabune be am noḡotama tabutabune.’
Inam riuvavasaḡinama ya saḡa guratana, be tauna e dokadokana.
Be aniwai rabuinama inam nama kitanama, ‘Turamma nuanuamma e paḡona, nema tam kwawai nuapaḡo munaḡemna nama.’
Tarawatu be peroveta adi waikatakataima matabudi inam riuvavasaḡidima rabui nopodie ta kenakenana.”
Keriso tauna aitau natuna?
Be Parisi ai rawateḡeidi da a miamia be Yesu yai taraviredina,
“Taumi Keriso nema ko noḡonoḡota bake, tauna aitau natuna?” Be taudi a paribee be a riuna, “Tauna guyau Deivid natunama.”
Be Yesu ya riuedina, “Be nemanama da Arua Babau guyau Deivid nopone ya yovo be tauna umanama ya riuna,

content.text: ‘Mamaitua yau Badama ya riuena, Kasaugue kwa miana, naumeki da taugu am ḡaviama kaḡamma dibudie yà biridina.’

content: Guyau Deivid Keriso ḡarone ya riuna, ‘Yau Badama!’ Be yodi nemanama da Keriso tauna guyau Deivid natuna?”
Inam dabudine nam aitau Bada na giuma i paribeena. Inam raḡanine be nokoi ya naḡona nam aitau Yesu waitaravira munaḡenama i ḡoena, baninama taudi a nairana.
